purpose: summary of executed regression builds; frozen baseline measurements live under direct-v1/

environment.fortran: GNU Fortran 13.3.0 in a private prefix (apt-get download + dpkg-deb -x, no sudo, no system file modified)
environment.cspice: CSPICE N0067, prebuilt external library (not sanitizer instrumented)

builds.name: GCC Release, both backends, CSPICE, tests
builds.regressions_preserved: all pre-existing kernel, integration, analysis and SPICE tests included in that count

builds.name: Clang Debug ASan/UBSan with both backends
builds.result: configured; build blocked by an external toolchain limitation, not by project code
builds.blocker: the private GNU Fortran prefix cannot link -fsanitize=address,undefined (no libasan_preinit.o / -lasan available for that compiler); the C++ objects are clang-instrumented, the reference Fortran object is not
builds.implication: no sanitizer claim is made for the JB2008 Fortran object; C++ and C reference paths were not exercised under sanitizers in this run

jb2008_official_set_grid_13328_rows.note: printed fixture rounds its solar inputs; the full-precision fixtures agree ~700x better, so the grid residual is dominated by printed-input resolution

independent_reference_measurements.source: docs/atmosphere/evidence/coordinate-reference-v1.json and the printf lines of tests/nrlmsise00_tests.cpp and tests/jb2008_tests.cpp
